name: @unieai/runtime-image-deps
description: External npm deps the runtime apps/packages import (sandbox-runtime / collab-runtime). These are normally hoisted to the repo-root node_modules via workspaces, but the runtime Docker images only COPY runtime/ (no root manifest), so this standalone manifest lets the image `npm install` them. NOT a workspace member (the root globs are runtime/apps/* + runtime/packages/*), so it's inert for local dev. Versions pinned to the repo root.
